text:
alex: Hey team, trying to spin up p4d in eu-west-1 for a customer trial but the account is stuck in "Payment verification". Console shows: "Payout setup failed: bank_entity_name_mismatch". Anyone seen this?
maria: Ugh, saw that before. Finance requires the bank account name to match registered business name exactly. Did we submit the VAT/W-8/W-9?
alex: We only uploaded a company registration PDF, no W-9. Payment portal rejects the payout webhook with 422.
finance: @alex can you DM the payment ticket id? We flagged the payout as high risk. We'll need the bank statement + proof of tax id. If US entity, W-9; if non-US, W-8BEN-E + local tax docs.
alex: Ticket #PAY-7842. Attached screenshot: https://redwood-internal.screenshots/7842.png
sam: For short term, you can request a fallback quota in us-west-2 (p4d) while finance clears EU. File for quota increase may need account to be in good standing though.
cloud-ops: Also note AWS sometimes blocks ENI quotas on EU accounts for new business registrations. Opened AWS case 1234567890. Will try to request temporary capacity.
maria: Finance says bank entity name mismatch — likely the bank account is under a DBA. Can we get a letter from bank or updated ACH docs? That usually fixes it.
alex: Customer is an EU GmbH but bank name shows the parent LLC in their SWIFT. They don't have quick bank letter. Any alternate path to get p4d scheduled?
sam: We can provision p3dn.24xlarge nodes temporarily — less throughput but available faster. Cost delta ~30% lower throughput per dollar. Want me to spin up a test pool?
alex: Yes please, spin up p3s for now. Also adding @finance to escalate — customer is in trial; need fast resolution :thumbsup:
finance: On it. I'll escalate to payments provider and request manual review. Please DM the company's legal name + tax id now.
alex: Sent. Thanks.
billing-bot: Payment provider updated status: manual_review_requested -> pending_documents (ETA 48h).
cloud-ops: AWS case updated: support says they can grant ENI quota exception after compliance clears or with a justification letter. Putting both tickets in one incident thread.
sam: Created temporary autoscaling pool in us-west-2 with 4 p3s, labels: trial-fallback. Keep me posted if we can move workload there.
alex: Noted. Closing loop when finance confirms. Thanks everyone :rocket:
